passes.name: Skill Check authoring and assessment coverage

findings.message: The withdrawn WEBD Revision 1 artifact remains preserved for comparison and is not a learner-catalog entry.
External resource access and exact boundaries must be rechecked before a future curriculum revision.

semanticValidation.method: Human-led adversarial review examined all 25 competency dependencies, 32 contextual concepts, bounded external Study assignments, 80 assessment targets, eight Build contracts, setup assumptions, session limits, accessibility progression, state/storage/network failure paths, Git safety, deployment boundaries, and required human evidence. Deterministic validators consume this judgment but do not create it.
findingsReviewed: Rejected Revision 1 generated concept-card pages and repeated microbuild wording as the primary learning route; Revision 2 uses inspected external instruction followed by observable browser practice.
Kept Week 1 deliberately gentle with no CSS, JavaScript, arithmetic, calculator, blank-page design, or repository publication.
Established localhost preview during setup so later relative paths and fetch do not rely on file URLs or an undisclosed server prerequisite.
Separated HTML semantics, CSS systems, responsive layout, small JavaScript behavior, canonical state, forms/accessibility, and network states into a dependency-respecting sequence.
Required actual validator, Elements, Styles, Computed, Console, Application, Network, keyboard, viewport, zoom, reload, and live-deployment evidence rather than unsupported quality claims.
Used local sanitized JSON fixtures rather than an external API, key, paid service, changing endpoint, or CORS-sensitive dependency.
Required all graded items to map to bounded Core instruction from the current or earlier Week, assess distinct decisions, and use plausible web-development distractors with shuffled runtime order.
Kept every instructional Build session at 105 minutes or less and every capstone segment at 90 minutes or less; setup is separate and capability-skippable after verification.
semanticValidation.adversarialResult: PASS after recorded repairs. A basic-computer-literate learner receives the environment, content, data, scaffolds, failure cases, review procedure, and deployment boundary needed to complete each artifact without inventing hidden architecture or relying on generic course-owned definition cards.
